articles.summary: Flowserve Business System Delivers Strong Q3 Performance; Updates 2026 Guidance Flowserve Corporation (NYSE: FLS), a leading provider of flow control products and services for the global infrastructure markets, reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Highlights: Bookings of $1.38 billion, up 14% on a reported basis and 8% organically versus the prior-year period Record aftermarket bookings of $728 million Operating margin of 12.5% expanded 580 basis points and adjusted 1 operating margin 2 of 16.5% expanded 170 basis points compared to the prior-year period Reported EPS of $0.81 and adjusted EPS 3 of $1.07 Raised the low end of full-year 2026 adjusted EPS 3 guidance to $4.10 to $4.20 Revised full-year 2026 organic sales guidance to down 2.5% to down 1.5% reflecting increasingly challenging conditions in the Middle East Backlog of $3.5 billion, up 20% year over year, the largest backlog in Flowserve’s history Management Commentary: "Our teams
